docs.summary:
Where each frame's main-thread time goes, by category, over the last [`HistoryLength`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Diagnostics.FrameStats~HistoryLength) frames.

```csharp
using FrameStatScope stats = FrameStats.Physics.Scope();  // built-in category, to the end of the method
using (FrameStats.Scope("AI")) UpdateAgents();             // your own, created on first use
using (FrameStats.Scope("AI/Paths")) FindPaths();          // grouped under AI in viewers
float avg = FrameStats.Render.GetStats(60).Avg;            // ms per frame, last 60 frames
```

Nested scopes count only their own time, so a frame's categories add up to its length, with unscoped time in [`Other`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Diagnostics.FrameStats~Other) and GC pauses in [`GC`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Diagnostics.FrameStats~GC). Scopes off the main thread record nothing.
How many frames of history are kept.
The editor's own work. Its subcategories are made by the editor.
Main thread blocked until the render thread has finished and presented earlier frames, vsync included.
The frame limiter sleeping to hold the target frame rate.
Garbage collector pauses. Filled in at frame end, never scoped.
Frame time no scope claimed. Filled in at frame end, never scoped.
Every category registered so far, subcategories included, in registration order. A parent always comes before its subcategories.
Number of frames recorded since startup, including those that have left the history.
Number of frames currently held in the history, at most [`HistoryLength`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Diagnostics.FrameStats~HistoryLength).
Length of a recorded frame in milliseconds. 0 is the most recent frame.

members.name: GetCategory
members.signature: public static FrameStat GetCategory(string path, Color? color = null)

docs.summary: Returns the category at this path, creating it the first time it is asked for. A path such as "Editor/Gizmos" makes a subcategory, and its parents too if they do not exist yet. Paths match whatever the case. `color` is used only when the category is created; otherwise one is picked from its path.
Opens a scope on the category at this path. See [`Scope`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Diagnostics.FrameStat~Scope).
